resources.string: Management server URL
The NetBird management server every profile connects to. Leave unset to let the user choose.
Pre-shared key
WireGuard pre-shared key applied to peer connections. The user never sees the value.
Post-quantum encryption
Enables Rosenpass key exchange in addition to WireGuard.
Allow peers without post-quantum encryption
Connects to peers that do not offer Rosenpass, instead of refusing them.
Disable client routes
Stops the device from using routes other peers advertise.
Disable server routes
Stops the device from advertising routes to other peers.
Block inbound connections
Drops connections opened by other peers towards this device.
Allow the SSH server
Lets other peers open an SSH session to this device.
Allow remote debug bundles
Lets the management server ask this device for a debug bundle.
Split tunnelling mode
Whether the applications listed below are the only ones in the tunnel (allow), or the only ones kept out of it (disallow).
Only the listed applications use the VPN
The listed applications bypass the VPN
Split tunnelling applications
Package names, separated by commas. Applications not installed on the device are ignored.
Hide profiles
Removes profile switching, creation and removal from the app.
Hide networks
Removes the Networks tab, leaving routing to the policy.
Hide advanced settings
Removes the advanced settings screen from the app.
WireGuard port
UDP port the tunnel binds to. Must be between 1 and 65535.
Extra interface blacklist

Interface name prefixes, separated by commas, whose local addresses are never offered as connection candidates. Case-sensitive, no wildcards. Added to the built-in list; does not change which network the device routes through.
Disable DNS
Stops the app from managing the device DNS. Names served by NetBird no longer resolve.
Disable firewall
The app no longer applies firewall rules on this device.
Disable IPv6
The device neither requests nor uses an IPv6 address on the NetBird network.
Block LAN access
Stops traffic routed through this device, as a router or exit node, from reaching its local network.
Tunnel MTU
MTU of the NetBird tunnel, between 576 and 8192. An out-of-range value is ignored.
Disable IPv6 discovery
Never offers IPv6 addresses as connection candidates to other peers.
DNS route update interval
How often routes for domain-based networks are refreshed, as a duration such as 30s, 1m or 1m30s.
Force relay
Never tries a direct connection and reaches every peer through a relay. All traffic of the device then goes through the relay servers.
Lazy connections
Connects to a peer on first use instead of at startup, overriding the setting the management server sends.
Debug bundle upload URL
Where remote debug bundles are uploaded. Must be an https URL. Leave unset to use the service the management server names.
Prevent changing settings
Leaves every setting visible but read-only.
